program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (16.0, 12.0, 20.0),     # diff-pair gm/Id (low Vgs -> tail headroom)
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Itail":   (30e-6, 16e-6, 60e-6),
    "gmid_ld": (9.0, 7.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror load & M7 (same gm/Id, L -> exact ratio)
    "L_ld":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),
    "I7":      (120e-6, 60e-6, 200e-6),
    "Cc":      (1.5e-12, 0.8e-12, 3e-12),
    "kRz":     (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = kRz / gm7
    "gmid_cs": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # NMOS current sources gm/Id
    "L_cs":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I7 = p["Itail"], p["I7"]
    Ih = It / 2

    # NMOS bias / current sources (same gm/Id, L -> clean mirroring)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_cs"], p["L_cs"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_cs"], p["L_cs"], It, vds=0.2)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_cs"], p["L_cs"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load and second-stage driver (same gm/Id & L)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ih, vds=1.0)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Rz = p["kRz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: sink IREF with diode nfet
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: vinn on diode side, vinp on output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd                     # first-stage node cap
    c2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (c1 * c2 + Cc * (c1 + c2)) / (2 * PI)
    denom = (1.0 / gm7 - Rz)
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * abs(denom)) if abs(denom) > 1e-12 else 1e15
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2))
    if denom < 0:      # LHP zero adds phase
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
    else:
        pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * c1)                      # pole from Rz
    pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    mirror_pole = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / mirror_pole)) * 0.5
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS 2nd stage, Rz-Cc compensation)
